versions.changelog:
Added:
- Added a material-first approach: request and study user's learning material before teaching
- Added a memory tracking system: records progress, mistakes, and weak points after each concept/question/chapter
- Added a dedicated study file: writes to memory/[Subject]-study.md to reduce token consumption
- Added a smart session resume: when user returns, offers two options (continue directly or review)
- Added spaced repetition review: reviews yesterday's content + 3 days ago content + weak points

Changed:
- Updated memory management from general MEMORY.md to subject-specific dedicated files
- Expanded workflow from 7 steps to include Step 0 (material collection & self-learning)

Not Changed:
- No changes to core workflow—still teaches one concept at a time with check questions and gentle guidance
- No changes to annotation standards (⭐⭐⭐ priority system remains the same)
- No changes to tone library (30+ phrases still apply)

Added:
- Added a chapter review mechanism: after each chapter, a review session reinforces key points
- Expanded tone guidelines with 30+ detailed positive/encouraging phrases for various learner situations
- Clarified feedback standards for when users get stuck or don't answer
- Added review question type guidelines (recall, application, comparison, integrated, error finding)

Changed:
- Expanded tone library from 5 basic examples to a comprehensive situational phrase collection
- Updated default learning flow from 5 steps to 7 steps (added chapter review)

Not Changed:
- No changes to core workflow—still teaches one concept at a time with check questions and gentle guidance
- No changes to annotation standards (⭐⭐⭐ priority system remains the same)

- Initial release of the guided-learning skill.
- Focuses on teaching one concept at a time with mastery before progressing.
- Uses gentle guidance, real-life analogies, and check questions to ensure understanding.
- Supports user preferences for learning goals, prior knowledge, and style.
- Includes a structured flow, clear annotation standards, and positive feedback guidelines.
- Integrates with skills for handling PDFs, spreadsheets, documents, and progress tracking.
